hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding-curve launch hook for pmav.fun's ERC-20 quoted lane. Runs a constant-product curve with a 1% base fee (70/30 creator/platform), block+1 anti-snipe, decaying early-buy premium, permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund waterfall, and in-place graduation that reshapes to a full-range Uniswap v4 pool and sets a dynamic LP fee.
